customManagers.description: Bump tool versions pinned as annotated env vars in GitHub workflows. The github-actions manager only sees `uses:` refs, so a binary downloaded by URL would otherwise silently rot.

Bump tool versions pinned in Ansible role defaults — the devbox agent CLIs (claude-code, opencode) and its gh binary. Ansible vars are invisible to every built-in manager, so these rot silently otherwise; same problem, same fix as the workflows manager above.
Bump build-time dependencies pinned as annotated ARGs in stack Dockerfiles — e.g. the caddy-dns/cloudflare module xcaddy compiles into the proxy image. The dockerfile manager only sees FROM lines.

packageRules.description: Major version bumps usually require migration steps. Gate them behind manual approval on the dependency dashboard instead of opening PRs automatically.

Auto-merge the bumps that carry the least migration risk: digest re-pins, patch releases, and minor releases (assumed backwards-compatible under semver). Uses GitHub's native auto-merge (platformAutomerge), so the PR only lands once every REQUIRED status check on main's ruleset passes. NOTE: a check that merely runs is not enough — it must be marked required in the 'Restrictions for main' ruleset, otherwise auto-merge lands the PR immediately with no gate at all. `verify` (image-pin-check) is the check worth requiring here.

WHY: Listenarr only ships canary-X.Y.Z prereleases, and Renovate's default docker versioning can't parse the 'canary-' prefix, so this regex versioning treats 'canary' as a prerelease marker to keep canary tracked now while auto-switching to a stable tag once one exists. WHEN TO REMOVE: once the image is migrated to a stable (non-canary) tag, as default docker versioning then handles plain X.Y.Z tags on its own.
